text: Here's how to set up Coatwright for commercial bids. It takes about two minutes, on your computer.
Open Settings, then tap the Commercial section.
Type your commercial labour rate, your overhead and profit, and your usual wall height. Then choose how you price: by labour hours, or by unit prices.
If you know them, add how fast you paint walls, and what you pay for wall and ceiling paint. That's it. Everything else already has typical commercial values.
Want more control? You can fine-tune each paint system here, any time.
Now every new blueprint takeoff starts with your numbers. Here's the bid tab, already using your rates.
Every job is different, so you can change anything on a single bid. It only affects that bid. Found a better number? Tap, Save as my default, and it's used on every bid after that.
You're set up. Questions? Email hello at getcoatwright dot com.
